limitations: macOS LocalReader reports UnsupportedPlatform; owned mapped-page reads execute on Android.
ASan/UBSan runs on host Debug, with leak detection disabled; Android sanitizer execution is unverified. Profiler ThreadSanitizer evidence is separate.
Generated AArch64 bytes are assembled/disassembled and never executed. Wrapper failure injection substitutes the external assembler/disassembler C ABI, not the wrapper implementation.
Portable Input archive compilation is required by producer installation; no Input runtime, InputEvent, Graphics, Overlay, Dobby, Vulkan, or actual hook acceptance is refreshed here.
Isolated Assembler-only/Disassembler-only packages and their source consumers are not reexecuted in this evidence.
Android device coverage is PLQ110/API36/4096-byte pages only. Other APIs, architectures, 16 KiB pages, hardening combinations, GPU drivers and DSO unloading are unverified.
GitHub Actions execution and all repository acceptance gates are not established by this scoped local evidence.
